articles.author: Daragh Thomas
articles.headline: Bessent Wants Chinese AI Sanctioned, But Jensen Huang Says Distillation Is Learning
articles.summary: Treasury threatens sanctions over Chinese AI "theft," but Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says distillation is just learning. Prediction markets side with his calm.
articles._summary: The pressure started Tuesday, when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Fox Business the administration is finding “watermarks of our U.S. large language models on many of the Chinese models” and may act within weeks. The practice at issue is distillation: bombarding a frontier model with prompts and training a cheaper model on its answers, capturing much of its capability at a fraction of the cost. The technique is a normal part of AI development when done openly.
articles._zh_headline: Bessent 希望中国人工智能受到制裁，但黄仁勋表示蒸馏就是学习
articles._zh_summary: 这种压力始于周二，当时财政部长斯科特·贝森特告诉福克斯商业频道，政府正在发现“我们的美国大语言模型在许多中国模型上的水印”，并可能在几周内采取行动。有争议的做法是蒸馏：用提示轰炸前沿模型，并根据其答案训练更便宜的模型，以一小部分成本捕获其大部分功能。当公开进行时，该技术是人工智能开发的正常组成部分。

articles._summary: The AI trade did more than propel chip stocks higher this year. It appears to have siphoned capital directly from some of the market’s most familiar monetary hedges. Since March, US semiconductor exchange-traded funds have drawn over $22 billion in cumulative inflows, while gold and Bitcoin funds have shed around $17.5 billion. The correlation between these moves suggests less a pair of separate investment narratives than a single, powerful rotation.

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Nvidia vs. AMD: The Next AI Battle Targets a $170 Billion Prize
articles.summary: Bank of America says the next AI war isn't about GPUs anymore. Nvidia and AMD are competing to define the future of a $170 billion server CPU market.
articles._summary: For nearly three years, investors judged the AI race by one metric: GPU performance. Bank of America thinks the next winner may depend on something far less discussed: server CPUs. The question isn’t which company builds the faster processor. It’s which metric customers decide matters most. Bank of America says Nvidia measures success by how quickly a single AI agent completes its work. “Nvidia introduced a new framework: max single-threaded performance at scale,” analyst Vivek Arya said.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia vs. AMD：下一场人工智能之战的目标是 1700 亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 近三年来，投资者通过一个指标来评判人工智能竞赛：GPU 性能。美国银行认为下一个赢家可能取决于一些很少被讨论的东西：服务器 CPU。问题不在于哪家公司生产更快的处理器。这是客户决定的最重要的指标。美国银行表示，英伟达通过单个人工智能代理完成工作的速度来衡量成功。 “Nvidia 推出了一个新框架：大规模单线程性能最大化，”分析师 Vivek Arya 说道。

articles.headline: What's Going on With Apple Stock Wednesday?
articles.summary: Apple slips in premarket as tech weakens. With Q3 earnings on July 30, can AAPL hold its bullish trend? Read the full analysis.
articles._summary: Investors are also watching whether Apple can hold onto its recent gains after a strong rally. The company is scheduled to report fiscal third-quarter earnings after the market closes on July 30. Apple continues to trade in a longer-term uptrend. The stock is 6.3% above its 20-day simple moving average of $308.48 and 19.2% above its 200-day SMA of $274.94. The 20-day SMA also remains above the 50-day SMA of $304.24, signaling that the intermediate trend is still positive.
articles._zh_headline: 周三苹果股票怎么样？
articles._zh_summary: 投资者也在关注苹果公司在强劲反弹后能否守住近期涨幅。该公司计划在 7 月 30 日收盘后公布第三财季收益。苹果公司的交易继续处于长期上升趋势。该股较 20 日简单移动平均线 308.48 美元高出 6.3%，比 200 日移动平均线 274.94 美元高出 19.2%。 20 日移动平均线也保持在 304.24 美元的 50 日移动平均线之上，表明中期趋势仍然积极。
